item.title: Threads is testing a shortcut to quickly start DM conversations
item.description: Users who are part of the test can type "DM me" or "Message me" in a post or reply to automatically generate a hyperlink that invites others to start a private conversation with them.

item.title: Mistral AI inks a deal with global consulting giant Accenture
item.description: Mistral AI lands a partnership with Accenture, the consultant that has also recently announced partnerships with rivals OpenAI and Anthropic.

item.title: Memory shortage could cause the biggest dip in smartphone shipments in over a decade
item.description: IDC says phone makers will ship only 1.12 billion smartphones as compared to 1.26 billion last year.

item.title: Sophia Space raises $10M seed to demo novel space computers
item.description: The company's modular computer tiles offer a new vision for space data centers.

item.title: So, we’re getting Prada Meta AI glasses, right?
item.description: Mark Zuckerberg was at Prada's fashion week event in Milan, leaving everyone to wonder if we're getting Meta AI glasses under the Prada brand.

item.title: Google paid startup Form Energy $1B for its massive 100-hour battery
item.description: The deal paves the way for Form Energy to raise a new funding round before potentially going public next year.

item.title: PayPal might not be looking to sell itself: Report
item.description: PayPal may not be in talks to be acquired, sources have told Semafor, after a previous news report that Stripe was sniffing around.

item.title: Anthropic CEO stands firm as Pentagon deadline looms
item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said Thursday that he "cannot in good conscience accede" to the Pentagon's demands to give the military unrestricted access to its AI systems.

item.title: Jack Dorsey just halved the size of Block’s employee base — and he says your company is next
item.description: Jack Dorsey has long been an open admirer of Elon Musk. Now, it seems, he may have been taking notes.

item.title: Netflix backs out of bid for Warner Bros. Discovery, giving studios, HBO, and CNN to Ellison-owned Paramount
item.description: In a one-two punch of centibillion-dollar offers, the bidding war for Warner Bros. Discovery is over. David Ellison-owned Paramount will acquire Warner Bros. Discovery. Netflix has lost.
